newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL rubber ends mixed after switch over new mths.
newsitem.headline: KL rubber ends mixed after switch over new mths.

text.p: Rubber prices closed mixed in slow trade after switch over to new months, with a firmer close in Tokyo did not help the market strongly.
Dealers said sentiment was seen more bearish among sheet rubber with new trading month August Int Ones buyer dropping 4.50 cents to 255 cents ($1.98) a kg.
Business was slow with some scattered seen by local dealers and thin participation from Europe because of summer holidays.
A check with trading houses showed SMR20 trading at around 243 cents a kg, the SMR5 at 255, the SMR10 at 245, the SMR L at 292 and SMR CV at 311. Drum latex was quoted at 212.
Demand for latex also dwindled considerably and the market does not expect much inquiries.
Some suppliers said there is sufficient stocks in the market, as sellers are not disposing heavy stocks on speculation of higher prices later.
"It is normal that demand is always slow during the summer time," a dealer said, adding latex demand was thin with few local dealers covering their nearby positions.
New trading month, August SMR 20 buyer ended a cent up at 245 cents a kg.
